name: The Cost Of Discipleship
overview: The Cost of Discipleship calls believers to a radical commitment to Christ that surpasses all earthly relationships and possessions. Jesus teaches that love for Him must exceed love for family, and that following Him requires self-denial and daily taking up one’s cross. The believer is warned that gaining the world is worthless if it means losing one’s soul, emphasizing the eternal value of wholehearted devotion to Christ. True discipleship demands a willingness to forsake even one’s own life in loyalty to Jesus.
